root: ^Congratulations, you've made it. As expected, you are our strongest warrior.

g-0: ^Frank, the one who left the message on the tablet for you, the leader of this spaceship. I was severely injured, so I also entered the cryo-pod to heal my wounds.
^Warrior, you’ve completed your mission. From here on, I will take control of the ship and prepare to meet with the Alliance Forces' ship.
^The Alliance Forces? Why can’t I remember anything?
g-1: ^I’m afraid the injuries you sustained earlier caused permanent damage to your brain. I’m sorry, it was my failure that led to this accident.
^If you have any questions, I can answer them.

questions: ^What was the mission of this voyage?

c-0:
^The Alliance Forces are a military organization formed by veterans of the old government. They have been the de facto rulers of the New Earth for over a decade.

^On the other side, the Resistance emerged five years ago, and now both sides are fighting for control of the New Earth.

^We are a scientific research team operating between the two, developing war weapons for both sides. The Alliance Forces are currently our employers.
c-1:
^To deliver a new batch of weapons to the Alliance Forces. The weapon you’re holding is our latest research achievement.

^However, an accident occurred during the journey. Thanks to you, things didn’t turn into a complete disaster.
c-2: ^A Resistance spy infiltrated our team and sabotaged our fuel bay, intending to kill everyone on the ship. Fortunately, you turned the tide and eliminated him in a critical moment, but you were severely injured in the process.
^The cryo-pod could heal your wounds, but it took a long time. By the time you woke up, all the other crew had already...

question2: ^The person who collapsed near the tablet is...?

g-0: ^She was a new member of our team, someone with a promising future... I deeply regret her sacrifice.
^But why was your tablet next to her...?
^The Resistance and their spy also lost contact, yet no one came...?
g-1: ^Wait a moment, the forces have arrived in orbit above the planet.
^Don’t overthink it. Leave everything to me from here on, and you should return to the cryo-pod to rest.
^(Frank turns around to operate the ship's console. Suddenly, You black out and fall to the ground.)
